children: Kustom Entertainment entered into a Unit Purchase Agreement to acquire all equity interests of TFL. The consideration totals $112 million, comprising $89.6 million in cash and $22.4 million in restricted common stock valued by a 10-day VWAP prior to closing, plus repayment of $35 million of TFL debt at closing. The deal includes $1.5 million in escrows and $11.2 million in holdback shares issuable upon achieving a Target EBITDA through 2027. The agreement includes customary conditions, a seller board designee at closing, and an outside date of Oct. 15, 2026, with a potential 15-day extension upon an S-1 filing.
